gap._description: No confirmed C emission gaps remain after current fixture review; differential and mutation are separate evidence requirements.

decisions.question: C has no class inheritance or interface hierarchy grammar constructs.
decisions.resolution: NOT APPLICABLE: C emits no extends, implements, or overrides relationships.

decisions.question: Function pointers, macro expansion, and preprocessor control flow cannot always be resolved statically.
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: opaque function-pointer targets and macro-expanded semantics are not fabricated as named relationships.

decisions.question: C completeness scope is tied to the pinned tree-sitter-c grammar.
decisions.resolution: The inventory is exhaustive for the current grammar; future grammar drift requires a new inventory review.

decisions.node_type: macro-mangled ERROR regions (EXPORT-macro prototypes, SQLITE_WSD phantom functions)
decisions.question: M37 #601 Holy C wave residuals (pinned 2026-09-05): sqlite 100% coverage @60/lang = 9 missing / 105 unexplained (242 @200/lang, 1.07%); jq 99.9% @60 = 4 missing / 28 unexplained (0.94%). Nearly all unexplained sit in 4 GENERATED amalgamation files (autosetup/jimsh0.c, ext/wasm/libcmpp.c, ext/jni/src/c/sqlite3-jni.c, sqlite3-wasm.c) whose JIM_EXPORT/CMPP__EXPORT prototypes and SQLITE_WSD macro-qualified struct definitions cannot parse without macro expansion (C-D2); missing = include-guard macro uses (JIM_SIGNAL_H/__JIM__H/...) and vendored dtoa config macros read inside ERROR-recovered preproc regions; real-file residuals are edges where the ANALYZER is correct (fn-pointer table value reads; ERROR-scope desync in jq builtin.c after a 12-line ERROR span at L2055). The glue-name asymmetry (analyzer isGlueFdName vs oracle isBareFdGlueName, F7 identity-antipattern) was closed positionally so glue-fd names (s3jni_config_log) are suppressed on BOTH sides.
decisions.resolution: RECORDED RESIDUAL: not fixable without macro expansion / whole-file ERROR-span rescoping; the CGD19/CGD33/CGD38 positional artifact rules suppress post-glue variable/type artifacts on BOTH sides. Guarded by: differential baseline floor (sqlite 9/105, jq 4/28 @60/lang - section E validates the jq:c row against this ruling), fixture cgd31-37-regressions pins CGD31-38, regression mutants all caught (251 total incl. 10 c). Any future grammar or corpus change that shifts these numbers regresses the baseline gate.

decisions.question: Holy-C second review (#736): the prototype branch hardcoded public visibility, so `static int hidden(int);` reported public and exported while static DEFINITIONS are private.
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-11): prototype visibility honors the static storage class (svelte/vue parity: definition and declaration agree); fixture c/declaration-identity (expectVisibility private + forbidExports) + mutant c/static-prototype-public CAUGHT.

decisions.question: Holy-C second review (#736): tentative definitions, extern+definition pairs and prototype+definition pairs emitted one symbol per occurrence (prototype+definition even double-exported).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-11): post-pass merges same-kind file-scope duplicates (definition wins over prototype, else first; scoped/owned and cross-kind collisions untouched); fixture c/declaration-identity (expectSymbolCount) + mutant c/reduplicate-merged-symbols CAUGHT; export duplicates additionally trip the harness-global uniqueness invariant. Boundary: cross-kind pairs (a function-pointer DECLARATION extracts as Variable, its DEFINITION as Function — vfstraceDlSym, sqlite3_base64_init) stay split; merging across kinds would hide genuine illegal-C collisions. 2 instances in the 60-file sqlite sample, no edge impact.

decisions.question: Holy-C second review (#736): K&R parameter names parse as bare identifiers in parameter_list and were dropped from the params payload (reads were already correct via the K&R declaration locals path).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-11): bare identifiers accepted as params with honest `any` type; fixture c/declaration-identity (expectParameters a+b on K&R add) + mutant c/drop-knr-params CAUGHT.

decisions.question: Holy-C second review (#736): injectPhantomSymbols (GLib/GTK `*_get_type` phantoms) had zero callers — dead phantom-minting machinery; separately, `extern` declarations export (best-effort public surface claim).
decisions.resolution: DELETED the dead method (CGD9 precedent; probe-verified zero callers — wiring it would contradict the no-phantom contract). `extern` exports KEPT by design: C has no module boundary and the declaration is real API surface readers need; stripping it would lose the symbol. Refuted-as-designed with probe evidence (CEX).

decisions.question: Deepest review (#736): the CGD19 per-ERROR-span verdict memo was instance state keyed by span startIndex with no per-file reset — a reused instance (differential lanes, F4 runs, batch indexing) applied file A's verdict to file B's same-offset ERROR span, silently dropping B's legitimate declarations (probe: A-glue@0/14 suppressed B-clean@24; fresh instance emits it).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + PROBE-PINNED (2026-09-11): memo cleared at analyze() entry (one line; intra-file memo intact, engine per-file path never affected). Not fixture-pinnable (fixtures run fresh instances by design) — pin is the re-runnable probe script/m14/tmp/c-review3-probe5.ts, cited here per the java-heuristic-classify precedent.

decisions.question: Deepest review (#736): file-scope prototype parameter names (`int libfn(int count);`) entered the declaredNames pre-pass, fabricating a dangling `uses main->count` for later reads (the oracle's isFunctionLocal already excluded parameter ancestry — mirror parity restored, no oracle change needed).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-11): parameter-list ancestry excluded from the pre-pass via isInsideParameterList; fixture c/declaration-identity (forbids uses main->count) + mutant c/proto-param-uses CAUGHT.

decisions.question: #901 (M60, F5 sqlite rotation): the c lane was the only 100%-coverage lane with MISSING=2, both `uses` edges on all-caps macro names read in expression position (ext/misc/basexx.c SQLITE_EXTENSION_INIT1; src/tclsqlite.c SQLITE_TCLAPI). Two independent defects: extractMacro skipped EVERY value-less define (a body test disguised as include-guard filtering), and even with the symbol minted, a read ABOVE its define stayed silent — the CGD26 pre-pass's directive gate rejects anything with a preproc_ ancestor, so the neighbouring isMacroName branch had been dead code since CGD26 and macros alone resolved order-dependently (functions/globals did not).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-20): the body test is gone (a `#define` declares a name whatever its body — 30 value-less defines across sqlite's src/*.c + ext/misc/*.c, include guards minted too, one Constant each) and isMacroDefinitionName(node) admits exactly the macro NAME field through the directive gate (field identity by span; preproc_arg bodies and directive-condition mentions keep the suppression). Fixture c/macro-forward-read (symbols M60_TRACE_FLAG/M60_API, forward `uses global -> M60_TRACE_FLAG`, tclsqlite declaration-token read with a multi-line signature) + mutants c/drop-valueless-macro-symbol and c/drop-forward-macro-uses CAUGHT; all 18 c mutants caught.

decisions.node_type: function-like macro name wrapping a declaration (truth/analyzer disagreement)
decisions.question: The jq c lane's residual after #901: `UNEXPLAINED src/parser.c :: uses yyparse -> YY_INITIAL_VALUE` — a FUNCTION-LIKE macro used to wrap declarations inside yyparse's body (L2229 parent macro_type_specifier, L2230 parent function_declarator). Pre-existing (measured before either #901 edit: MISSING=0 unexplained=1 with the same totals; jq has no forward macro read, so #901's fixes do not touch this lane). A blanket 'function-like macro names are never reads' suppression was attempted and REVERTED — it removed this row and produced MISSING=4 (isleap, YYDPRINTF, decFinish, CFUNC), because the truth counts a macro INVOCATION as BOTH `calls (expr)` and `uses (expr)` and the analyzer's identifier-path uses is the load-bearing match for the second row.
decisions.resolution: REGISTERED as #908 (2026-09-20), with the shape, the four-row lesson as a regression test, and the open adjudication: on the same tree truth derives no row although its CGD13 exemption puts macro names in declaredNames and its use gate should admit the L2229 mention — either its walk misses the mention or a gate excludes it, and one side is wrong. A warning comment now sits at the declaredNames pre-pass so the reverted attempt is not repeated. c's diff column stays red on this single named, reproduced residual. Status at 2026-09-21: still OPEN as #908 — unchanged by the #907 and #910 rounds (the jq c lane's unexplained count is still exactly this one row).

decisions.node_type: swallowed top-level definitions (symbol loss under brace imbalance)
decisions.question: Found by the clang-reference audit of the jq error files (#743's second question): jq src/jv_print.c's public functions `void jv_dumpf`/`void jv_dump` are absent from the catalog entirely (no symbol, no edges) while jv_show/jv_dump_string/jv_dump_string_trunc are present. Mechanism bisected: a brace imbalance (preprocessor-conditional body) makes lines 219-395 parse as ONE function_definition — jv_dump_term's body swallows the rest — and the recovery path that saves nested function_definition nodes does not cover the pair arriving as declaration + compound_statement. The file's first ERROR row is 443, AFTER both definitions, so this is not 'the error region'. F5 cannot see it: a lost symbol produces no lost edge (both sides share the tree).
decisions.resolution: FIXED + GATED (2026-09-21, #907 closed at 13880055): the recovery path now covers the glued arrivals measured on real files — a root-level ERROR holding a bare function_declarator, a pointer-wrapped declarator, a static header, and the decNumber.c arrival shape — and clang's own reference is the acceptance oracle (the audit it drives was corrected in the same round: it counted every FunctionDecl clang attributes to the main file, and because the audit strips `#include <...>` clang relocates libc's implicit prototypes into the stripped file where they carry no location, so 314 claimed losses were 48 real; a definition is now FunctionDecl + CompoundStmt, artifact validation/m12/results/c-clang-def-audit.json). Measured: jq src/jv_print.c lost-defs 2 -> 0 (13 clang defs vs 13 symbols, both targets present); whole-corpus A/B over 434 c files added 23 symbols, every one verified against the source text as a real definition header, 0 non-definition additions and 0 duplicate names; the class-wide jq count 48 -> 39, whose residue (38 flex aliases with no source location and one call-shaped macro-driven site) is named in reviews/m60-907-c-glued-definitions.md and filed as #912. Fixtures c/swallowed-definitions-907, c/swallowed-root-definitions-907, c/swallowed-identifier-arrival-907 + five mutants; c fixtures 12/12, c mutants 27/27, and jq:c canonical 2929/2929 MISSING=0 unexplained=1 (#908).

decisions.node_type: the include ontology (#include as a graph relationship)
decisions.question: M60/#910: c emitted `#include` as a `references` edge carrying metadata.isImport/include_dependency, while typescript/javascript/python/dart/bash/lua/makefile emit the dedicated `imports` kind. Nothing consumed either marker (zero readers outside the analyzers), and the one import-aware reader — the LSP usages file-level section — filters relationship_type IN ('imports','exports') with the root symbol as target, so a c file's dependency list was unanswerable in that surface regardless of how the edge was typed: the include is file -> file with an external specifier, so it has no symbol endpoint on either side. Measured at 4bf9878f: 60-file sample 422 relationships, 0 with a line; 400-file slice 1176 include-ish edges typed `references`.
decisions.resolution: RULED as FIRST-CLASS `imports`, landed c first (2026-09-21) and rolled to the other five languages as their lanes come up. What the ruling means concretely: (1) the analyzer emits the dedicated `imports` kind, target = the path AS WRITTEN (quotes/brackets stripped — the evidence, never a resolved or invented path), line = the path token, metadata keeps relationshipType/isSystemInclude/isImport plus module + fileLevel; (2) the store names the IMPORTER on a file-level row (source_external = the importing file's project-relative path) instead of the file-scope placeholder `global`, so the row can answer 'what does this file include'; (3) brain_import.is_external carries the analyzer's own classification — `<stdio.h>` external, "util.h" internal — where the pool's bare-specifier heuristic (a js/ts idiom) had made both external, and where the store had hardcoded 0 for every language that declares it (c/cpp isSystemInclude, clojure/sql isExternal); (4) the usages response gains an OUTGOING section, fileLevel.dependencies, read by exact importer path, declared separately from the incoming imports/exports rows so 'what this file includes' can never be confused with 'who imports this'. Named limitation: the incoming direction for headers ('who includes this file') is NOT served — the stored specifier is the path as written while the viewed file is a project path, so an exact match is impossible and a basename match would be a guess. Gated by script/m60/verify-910-c-includes.ts on a real index (5 mutants, all caught) plus fixtures c/callsite-lines-825, c/c-completeness, c/macro-composed-include (which now also FORBID the downgraded shape) and mutant c/include-kind-downgraded. Oracle lockstep: the c truth derives the same `imports` label, and the differential's c label allowlist had to admit it — measured 129 MISSING on a 40-file sqlite draw when the oracle changed before the harness allowlist did.

decisions.question: M60/#917 (the residue #916 registered): the vendored families define functions through an export macro standing where the declaration specifier belongs (`CMPP__EXPORT(int, cmpp_stream)( cmpp_input_f inF, … ){ … }`, `S3JniApi(sqlite3_value_text16(),jstring,1value_1text16)(…)`). The published grammar reads the heading as `MACRO(ret, name)` CALLED with `(params)`, so the body is an orphan `compound_statement`, no `function_definition` exists, the definition is not a symbol, its locals publish as FILE-SCOPE names, and every read in its body is attributed to `global`. Counted with the fix's own predicate: 235 headings on sqlite (`ext/jni/src/c/sqlite3-jni.c` 149, `ext/wasm/libcmpp.c` 86), 0 in jq. Two adjudications were needed: is the heading's NAMING occurrence a declaration or a read (it is the defining occurrence, so a declaration), and does truth owe the body a function scope (it does — the oracle's `fnLocals` only runs for `function_definition`, so registering the body's bindings on the analyzer side would suppress a read truth still derives, a MISSING edge created by the fix itself).
decisions.resolution: RULED + FIXED (2026-09-22, #917). One SHAPE RULE, exported by the analyzer (`macroWrappedHeadingShape` / `wrappedBodyAfter`) and imported by the F5 oracle, refusals included (no top-level comma in the macro's argument list ⇒ refused: the separator is the evidence, because a pointer return type puts its type words in a `binary_expression` and leaves one identifier standing; name == macro name and C keywords refused too). The declared name is the macro's LAST identifier argument, and because the C lexer cannot start an identifier with a digit the JNI-mangled spellings arrive split into an `ERROR` holding the leading digits beside the identifier; the join is gated on adjacency and on the ERROR being nothing but a digit-led name fragment. Three call-site gates: `isInsideFunction()` (C has no nested definitions, so an ordinary call chain + block is never a definition), `gluedDefNameOffsets` (the naming occurrence is a declaration — without it the result was ORDER-DEPENDENT: `xTokenize` silent until an earlier heading minted the symbol), and no locals model for the recovered function (mirror of the oracle's `function_definition`-only `fnLocals`). Oracle lockstep was forced by measurement: 67 of the 235 names are also `#define`d in alternative preprocessor branches of the same file, so truth emitted `uses -> cmpp_stream` for the heading that DEFINES `cmpp_stream` (lane MISSING=67) — the mirror is a SKIP on that exact occurrence, never a suppression of the label. Diagnosing it required matching the lane's ENTRY (the analyzer class) to the instrument's (`parseFile`, whose post-processing drops one ERROR-parented mention, `libcmpp.c:9003`). Measured: sqlite:c 315 files `34645/34645 MISSING=0 | 34645 edges unexplained=0 (0%) heuristic=0` from `unexplained=1` — the lane's last unexplained edge (the `BufSize` leak) is gone because the body finally has a Function scope; cpp 28/28/0; jq/fmt/nlohmann byte-identical. Analyzer A/B: 2 files changed, 233 symbols added, 2 removed, 1231 edges removed / 1980 added, REAL-LOSS 0 both ways (1162 re-attributions across 524 pairs, 67 heading-name rows, 2 leaked-local rows). Fixture `c/macro-wrapped-heading-917` (three spellings + controls) proves teeth by revert 14/1 → 15/0; mutant `c/macro-wrapped-heading-loss` caught, c mutants 30/30; F3 c 15/15; F1 all 41 as before; F10 exit 0 (grammar untouched). Registered residue: the POINTER-return spelling (`CMPP__EXPORT(void *, cmpp_mrealloc)(…)`, 6 sites, 1 file, 5 of the 6 names surviving only as their `#define`) is refused by name in the fixture's header and filed as #918.

decisions.node_type: pointer-return macro-wrapped function headings (MACRO(ret*, name)(params){ body })
decisions.question: M60/#918 (the sibling #917's close-out registered by name rather than folding in): the same vendored export macro, but with a POINTER return type (`CMPP__EXPORT(void *, cmpp_mrealloc)(void * p, size_t n){…}`, `CMPP__EXPORT(char const *, cmpp_rc_cstr)(int rc){…}`, `CMPP__EXPORT(cmpp_b *, cmpp_b_borrow)(cmpp *pp){…}`). The parse does NOT orphan the body here — the grammar accepts the heading as a `function_definition` (or, where recovery swallows the region, a `declaration`) whose `type` field is a `macro_type_specifier` holding BOTH macro arguments, the return type inside an ERROR-wrapped `type_descriptor` carrying an `abstract_pointer_declarator` and the NAME as the specifier's LAST named child, with the PARAMETER list in the `declarator` field. The analyzer's declarator route looks for a `function_declarator`, so CGD38's guard drops the node: the definition was never a symbol, its body never a Function scope, and five of the six measured names existed only as the `#define`d macro constant from the file's thunk block. Counted with the fix's own predicate: 6 sites, 1 file (`ext/wasm/libcmpp.c`), 0 in jq.
decisions.resolution: RULED + FIXED (2026-09-22, #918). One shape rule, exported by the analyzer (`macroWrappedTypedHeadingShape`) and shared with the F5 oracle, refusals included. The POINTER is the discriminator and is REQUIRED: `abstract_pointer_declarator` inside the macro's first argument is the parse's own evidence for this spelling, and it is what keeps the VALUE-return headings (the #917 class, whose body is orphaned instead) out of this rule — the reverse is structural too, because a value-return heading's `type` field is never a `macro_type_specifier`. The NAME is read by POSITION (the specifier's last named child, and it must FOLLOW the return-type ERROR), never by node type: for `cmpp_b *` the return type's base is itself a `type_identifier`, so 'the type_identifier that is not the return type' would be a guess. The parameter payload is read structurally: each group's declared name is the RIGHTMOST non-keyword identifier in source order, and a lone identifier is an UNNAMED parameter (`cmpp_b_clear(void)` reports `unknown:void`, never naming the definition after a type word). The DECLARATION spelling is accepted only with all four pieces present (all-identifier ERROR tail, `parenthesized_declarator`, a lone `}` as the declaration's next sibling, no MISSING token but the list's mended `)`), so no span is ever invented. Exactly one asymmetry between the two spellings, and it is a MIRROR: the oracle keys `fnLocals` by `function_definition` startIndex, so the function_definition spelling gets truth-side locals (collected from body declarations) and the declaration spelling gets none — the analyzer registers locals for the first and joins `macroWrappedFunctionNames` (the #917 contract for this) for the second, because registering locals the oracle cannot see fabricates MISSING rows. Measured: A/B over four c corpora — 1 file changed (`ext/wasm/libcmpp.c`), jq/fmt/nlohmann byte-identical; symbols +6/-1 (the single removal is the L219 PROTOTYPE of cmpp_rc_cstr superseded by its definition under the one-symbol-per-name contract); edges +0/-0 at the lane's own pair granularity with 23 re-attributions from `global` to the recovered function; REAL LOSS 0 both ways. Lane: sqlite:c 315 files `34645/34645 (100%) MISSING=0 | 34645 edges unexplained=0 (0%) heuristic=0`, cpp 28/28/0. Fixture c/macro-wrapped-pointer-heading-918 (three pointer spellings, the declaration spelling in the real file's `#ifdef __cplusplus / extern "C" {` context, a value-return CONTROL, an ordinary pointer-returning function + prototype CONTROL, and the unnamed-parameter CONTROL) proves teeth by revert 15/1 -> 16/0; mutant c/macro-wrapped-pointer-heading-loss caught by that fixture alone. NOT claimed: a third sub-shape seen while authoring (the same heading whose body is several statements, leaving the declaration with no glued ERROR tail and the body at file scope) — the census says it occurs in neither c corpus, so the rule refuses it rather than inventing a span.
